items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: Well, Brother Cornbread used to take lessons with old man Chalney. Him and I was a scholar over there

ctx.x: I was going to ask about Chalney again. Somebody told me, maybe it was Harold Dejan, I think, took some lessons from him. Or what's it, Brother Cornbread or something, you know, the clarinetist.
Well, Brother Cornbread used to take lessons with old man Chalney. Him and I was a scholar over there, because he had a very large place, and he had just so many youngsters.
Maybe he said he had a band, didn't he?
